takeaways.t: US crude jumped 4.2% to $103.67 on Middle East fears; gold hit its lowest since July.
Record $20.1B revenue (+9%) and profit up 28% to $3.71B, but stock fell 3.7% on a slight miss and ~3,500 job cuts.
SK Hynix shelved a Solidigm US listing, Firmus scrapped its IPO, and Oura delayed its own.
Reportedly trimmed its funding target to $1.25T from $1.4T on softer demand.
AT&T fell 8% and T-Mobile 7.7% on reports SpaceX is seeking access to 80,000 cell towers.
US luxury spending fell 6% in September while high earners drove most Beige Book districts.

issues.title: Dynamic Duo

takeaways.t: Renewed AI-overspending worries pushed the Nasdaq down 2.60% and the S&P 500 down 1.21%.
Shares plunged after cancer-vaccine study results reportedly leaked on social media.
Musk reportedly put about $1B into Skydance, the Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery combination.
JPMorgan, Morgan Stanley and Bank of America are racing to restrict unvetted AI agents on customer accounts.
PPG expects data center paint sales to triple this year; its quarterly sales grew 7% to $4.5B.
Apple's $1,999 foldable got mixed reviews: strong battery and screen, but heavy, hot, with no Face ID.

issues.note: Market numbers are the Oct 22 close.

takeaways.t: Nasdaq had its worst day since June.
AI spending worries. Stock split in January keeps Zuckerberg's voting control.
Fuel up 68% at American, but premium-cabin revenue is growing 17-23%.
Staples +5%, healthcare at a record, P&G +5.6%, Lockheed +6.9%.
Lam Research -11.8%. Semis had their worst week since April 2025.
